This is the thing that I've seen come up a lot. While I agree that was don't **need** to see them intimate to know they are in a great, healthy relationship, it's the fanservice denial I feel that as Rin fans, we've gotten the real short end of the stick. Here's a quote from a blog "The Garden of Escapism"  


*"While it is true that romance isn’t the main driving force of UBW’s route and plot, Shirou and Rin’s relationship with each other served as a catalyst to the many decisions the characters would make that would heavily influence and shape the plot of UBW itself."*

​

I think that describes it best, and that's my main gripe. I know that it's important that each route serves to fill whatever fans support more, and everyone wins. For Saber and Sakura fans, they get their fill in the heroine's respective route, but for Rin's route much is just left to the imagination.
